title: Plugin Enriched Metadata
description: Structured metadata record for a Jenkins plugin, combining migration history with data sourced from the Jenkins Update Center.

pluginName.description: Short identifier of the Jenkins plugin (e.g. 'extra-tool-installers').

pluginRepository.description: URL of the plugin's Git repository.

maintainers.description: List of current plugin maintainers sourced from the Jenkins Update Center.

email.description: E-mail address of the maintainer (may be empty).

parentPomStatus.description: Status of the plugin's parent POM based on modernization history.

status.description: Result of the latest parent-POM upgrade attempt.

lastRecipe.description: Recipe ID of the most recent parent-POM migration.

lastTimestamp.description: Timestamp of the most recent parent-POM migration.

pullRequestUrl.description: URL of the pull request created for the parent-POM upgrade.

pullRequestStatus.description: Merge status of the parent-POM upgrade pull request.

deprecatedApiUsage.description: Summary of deprecated API usage and remediation status.

hasDeprecatedApis.description: True when deprecated APIs are known to still be present; null when no relevant migration has been attempted.

addressedRecipes.description: Recipe IDs that have been successfully applied to remove deprecated API usage.

pendingRecipes.description: Recipe IDs that attempted to address deprecated APIs but have not yet succeeded.

lastTimestamp.description: Timestamp of the most recent deprecated-API migration attempt.

testFrameworkVersion.description: Test framework version in use based on modernization history.

migrationStatus.description: Status of the JUnit 5 migration (success / fail / pending).

lastMigrationTimestamp.description: Timestamp of the most recent test-framework migration attempt.

pullRequestUrl.description: URL of the pull request created for the test-framework migration.

pullRequestStatus.description: Merge status of the test-framework migration pull request.

appliedRecipes.description: Unique IDs of all modernization recipes applied successfully to this plugin.
